messages:
Samir Shah: Raising a design thread: how do we serve ensembles where each model shard/variant uses different quant profiles (fp8/int8/4bit)? need consistent logits merging and KV cache semantics.
Lydia Park: Good call. Main headaches: logits scale mismatch, KV cache precision mismatch, and differing latency/throughput per model.
Vikram Rao: For logits merge, we can normalize logits to float32 in runtime and merge (avg or weighted). but converting every models output to fp32 hurts perf. maybe do per-model scale metadata and a fast affine normalize in fp16.
Samir Shah: agreed: profile should publish a small "output_scale" and "score_type" (logits|logprob) so runtime can do: merged = sum(weight * (raw*scale + bias)). Implement in fp16 hot path.
Lydia Park: KV cache: if ensemble members have different kv_precision, we must store separate caches per-precision or store all kvs in highest precision and cast on read. Memory vs perf tradeoff.
Vikram Rao: prefer separate caches per-precision keyed by model_variant. storage grows but avoids casts during hot path. we can GC unused per-tenant caches.
Samir Shah: latency: some models (fp8) are faster. ensemble weighting should consider latency budget. e.g., if tail-slower model misses deadline, runtime should proceed with partial ensemble and mark fallback. include a soft timeout per-call.
Lydia Park: voting/consensus semantics: if partial ensemble used, compute confidence delta and if below threshold, trigger fallback to single trusted high-fidelity model. define per-endpoint quality budget.
Vikram Rao: calibration: ensemble members need cross-model calibration so probabilities are comparable. propose a per-model calibration vector computed offline on anchor set and stored in profile meta (temp linear correction).
Samir Shah: yes: profile meta fields: calibration_scale, output_bias for quick affine correction before merging. also store expected latency p95 to inform weighting.
Lydia Park: rollout: initial support: 1) offline eval of ensemble merged outputs vs baseline, 2) shadow canary where runtime merges but does not return merged result to client, 3) staged canary with partial traffic and observability.
Vikram Rao: telemetry: emit ensemble partiality rate, per-variant fallbacks, merged_confidence, and KV-cache-miss-by-precision. sample raw logits only on failures.
Samir Shah: request header design: compact header to declare ensemble membership and weights: e.g. "ens:base=1.0,aux=0.5;deadline_ms=120". runtime falls back to weights in profile if header absent.
Lydia Park: caching keys: use (tenant, conversation_id, model_variant) so multiple caches can coexist. need GC policy when tenant switches ensemble composition.
Vikram Rao: deterministic replay for debugging: store which variants were used and partial flags in request trace so we can replay exact run. attach profile_ids and calibration_versions.
Samir Shah: safety: require that at least one ensemble member is >= int8 for safety-sensitive endpoints. lint profile to block ensembles that downgrade all members below threshold.
Lydia Park: evaluation: build ensemble anchors: combine model outputs offline and check for token-level divergence and human-eval on ensemble output. if ensemble harms pass-rate vs baseline, block.
Vikram Rao: action items: runtime: fp16 merge hotpath + partial-ensemble timeout support (Vikram). ML: calibration vector pipeline + ensemble anchor eval (Lydia). infra: multi-precision KV caches + GC (Samir).
ops-bot: Created task ML-5012: "Ensemble serving with heterogeneous quant profiles" assigned to Samir Shah, Lydia Park, Vikram Rao. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-5012 :white_check_mark:
Samir Shah: timeline: prototype fp16 merge and partial-ensemble timeout in 2 sprints. Lydia/Vikram align on anchors and cache design next week.
Lydia Park: I'll draft profile schema additions and lint checks today.
Vikram Rao: I'll prototype the merge and timeout hooks.
Samir Shah: thanks all, we'll sync after prototypes. :rocket:
